image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a lionfish (Pterois) swimming above a coral reef. The fish displays characteristic red and white vertical stripes, large fan-like pectoral fins with elongated rays, and a dorsal fin with prominent venomous spines. The background is a solid blue, likely an aquarium tank, with textured coral in the foreground.
